MindX attendance demo uses pretrained face models from OpenCV Zoo.

Upstream: https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_detection_yunet
Authors credited upstream: Wei Wu, Hanyang Peng, Shiqi Yu and contributors.

Upstream: https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_recognition_sface

GitHub source revision: 47534e27c9851bb1128ccc0102f1145e27f23f98
Official Hugging Face mirror revision: d4938dfc9d4ec5d098bfa33e98b3f3345a236586
Exact model filenames, SHA-256, sizes and download URLs are pinned in
school_app/vision/model_assets.py. Model weights are used unchanged.

The application integration, scope/version controls and attendance workflow are
project code. The project does not claim to have invented or trained YuNet/SFace.
Third-party copyright remains with its respective owners.
